exercises.prompt: Kylian Mbappé is only 19 years old.
exercises.why: Type I. a) After Ц the stressed ending is -ов, the unstressed is -ев: отцов, продавцов, but: американцев, немцев, месяцев. b) Masculine nouns in -й have -ев in the genitive plural: трамвай — трамваев. Type II. a) The nouns мать and дочь keep -ер- throughout the plural: N. pl.: матери, дочери; G. pl.: матерей, дочерей. b) The noun соседи (which is soft in the plural), also the nouns люди, дети, and родители (used in plural only) belong to type II: G. pl.: соседей, людей, родителей, детей. Type III. a) The genitive plural of feminine and neuter nouns of this type often has an inserted -е- or -о- between any two consonants at the end of the word. 1. They always take -е- between a sibilant and… — DLI, Lesson 38.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
